explanation: L13/H7 is a referential-entity (antecedent) retrieval head: at a token that follows or refers back to an already-introduced nominal — most often the finite verb or auxiliary after a clause's subject, but also a possessive 's or a preposition after its noun, a pronoun or complementizer with an antecedent, or punctuation closing an appositive — it puts most of its attention (0.7-0.98 at the peaks) on the last token of that nominal (a proper name, a kin or role noun such as father/teacher/senator, an institution, a place, or a concrete noun already mentioned), and its write is dominated by that token's value vector. It is active at about 9% of scanned tokens (roughly a quarter of finite verbs and auxiliaries, a sixth of adpositions, plus many possessives, pronouns and commas that follow a noun phrase), strongest when one salient nominal takes 0.7+ of the attention, and quiet when no referential entity is retrievable — at the start of a text or clause before any entity, after mass, abstract or scenario nouns (weather, economy, situation, evidence, music), and after non-referring pronouns or quantifiers (someone, somebody, nobody, everything) or first-mention indefinites — where the attention stays on the first-token sink or a filler and the write falls to its floor.
